svg.title: What runs where in a Felix deployment, and what each part needs
svg.desc: Three Felix processes share one image and one database. The API serves every protocol surface; the worker executes periodic tasks; the scheduler holds the cron labels and does nothing else — omit it and no task ever fires. A one-shot migrate container runs Alembic to head and every other service waits for it to complete, which CI asserts against the rendered compose config rather than trusting the YAML. Postgres with pgvector is the system of record; Valkey carries the broker, rate limits, run queues, steering and cross-replica session wakes. The object store is pluggable and defaults to the filesystem, so the base stack pulls no cloud SDK.
